verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a first-party 'Unleash Open Source' edition and a public GitHub repository that users can clone to run the server. Independent community comments also describe Unleash as an open-source, self-hosted alternative. However, no evidence names the license or confirms that all of the source, including enterprise features, is under an open license. missing for 10: explicit license identification (e.g., a named OSI license), documentation of which components are open versus proprietary, independent confirmation of license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: This guide helps you set up Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment using Docker.
clone the Unleash repository and start the server with Docker Compose
Asked for an open-source, self-hosted alternative to LaunchDarkly, a commenter recommended Unleash (github.com/Unleash/unleash).
